The one thing that matters most

Grok Bot's weekly update adds shopping: shopping cards, product pages, order tracking and payments, plus custom modes and shareable Team Bots.

Matt Palmer's "What's New in Grok Bot" video also covers Team Bot logins, connector asks in Slack and contacts in Vault, and Elon Musk quoted it as "Grok @Bot improvements" (6,409 likes). Also: OpenAI launched LifeVal, a benchmark built from ChatGPT users' everyday tasks; Tibo says GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Terra will join the models behind dots; and the Anthropic Residency announcement was the most-liked post from the watch list (30,120 likes).

LifeVal, a new benchmark shaped by feedback from thousands of ChatGPT users on the everyday tasks they most want a personal assistant to help with (6,052 likes).

For AGI to benefit all of humanity, it should help people with the everyday tasks that matter most to them. So we built LifeVal, a new benchmark shaped by feedback from thousands of ChatGPT users on where they most want help from a personal assistant—from finding childcare to accessing government services to managing personal finances.

Over the past year, we’ve used LifeVal to measure and improve how well our models handle these everyday tasks.

Riley Brown@rileybrown · Nov 2

Your agent (Claude Code, Codex, Grok Bot) can now search millions of podcast transcripts to ground its work in a real point of view.

Your Agent can now search through millions of podcast transcripts.

Whether you use Claude Code, Codex, Grokbot etc...

This is useful for many reasons.

The first reason is it allows you to find better podcasts to listen to.

But also. this allows your agents to grab a perspective before doing a given task. If you ask it to create a landing page, or create content script or anything else that requires a cultural understanding you can send it to a specific podcast or group of podcasts and this will ground your agent in a perspective.

This will improve its tone, understanding of any niche, and the accuracy of the response.

I've been using a custom built solution for this for months and it kinda sucked... but now it works great and its fast... this video feels sponsored but it's not.... just genuinely useful.

look closer.

an engine has one job - turn. the pistons push down, the rods spin the crank, up-and-down becomes round-and-round.

four models, same prompt, same engine:
Claude Opus 5.5 · GPT-6 Astra · Gemini 4 Argon · Grok 4.7
